description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. No internal corridor — fully open layout. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on end wall. Seating: sofa in centre of living zone facing the TV on the lower exterior wall; dining table on the left side near kitchen. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall opposite wall to entry. Cook can see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: direct into kitchen, first thing visible on arrival is kitchen. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Storage: one wardrobe. One bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: large families needing multiple bedrooms; households requiring a home office or dedicated work space; roommates needing separate private bedrooms.
not_suitable_for: households requiring a home office or dedicated work space
